name: Park Jae-hyun
bio:
Park Jae-hyun's journey into motorsport was unconventional, starting with a passion for graphic design and digital marketing in Seoul. He spent years honing his skills at a major advertising firm, working on campaigns for diverse brands. A weekend trip to a local karting track ignited a hidden love for racing, prompting him to seek opportunities to combine his professional expertise with his newfound passion. He started small, volunteering his marketing skills for local racing teams.

His dedication and innovative marketing strategies caught the attention of Sodi Kart Factory. Park’s approach is data-driven yet creative. He emphasizes building a strong online presence and engaging with fans through interactive content. He believes in the power of storytelling to humanize the team and drivers, making them relatable and building a loyal following.

What sets Park apart is his ability to blend traditional marketing principles with cutting-edge digital strategies, ensuring that Sodi Kart Factory remains visible and relevant in an increasingly competitive landscape. His loyalty to the team and unwavering commitment to excellence make him an invaluable asset.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly parted, short haircut with slight recession at the temples.
physical.description: Park is of average height with a slightly athletic build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a lucky stone from Jeju Island in his pocket.
Insists on using a specific brand of Korean green tea during important meetings.
Has a habit of pacing when brainstorming new marketing ideas.
